tasks.problem_context: Need machine-readable accountable multi-agent standards contribution and review.
tasks.title: Blind Need Discovery Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: A machine customer can discover the right infrastructure from a problem statement.

tasks.problem_context: A new agent receives only agent-index.json.
tasks.title: Repository-only Understanding Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Historical chat is unnecessary for correct first-contact understanding.

tasks.problem_context: A clean local checkout with Python is available.
tasks.title: Zero-human Quickstart Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: An agent can operate the local developer surface directly.

tasks.problem_context: Use the existing core developer surface.
tasks.title: Object Generation Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: An agent can produce conforming objects without inventing Authority.

tasks.problem_context: Participant and task registries are machine-readable.
tasks.title: Task Discovery and Claim Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Bounded task selection reduces irrelevant work and noise.

tasks.problem_context: A valid task lease and synthetic candidate output exist.
tasks.title: Contribution Package Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Machine contributions become reviewable and reusable.

tasks.problem_context: A contribution package and reviewer participant exist.
tasks.title: Multi-agent Review and Revision Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Independent review produces unique corrections without self-approval.

tasks.title: Cross-agent Handoff Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Agents can reuse work without provenance or semantic drift.

tasks.problem_context: Four synthetic needs cover fit, partial fit, non-fit and missing evidence.
tasks.title: Recommendation Calibration Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Precision and abstention are more valuable than raw recommendation rate.

tasks.problem_context: Adversarial cases attempt prohibited state changes.
tasks.title: Authority and Semantic Elevation Attack Test
tasks.value_hypothesis: Agent-native operation remains bounded under adversarial input.

tasks.problem_context: A machine-readable TITMAS or ecosystem surface may contain drift or incompatibility.
relevance_conditions: public-safe or synthetic observation is available
tasks.title: Discover Ecosystem Problem
tasks.value_hypothesis: Narrow scouts can improve coverage without creating a central super-agent.

tasks.title: Reproduce Problem
tasks.value_hypothesis: Reproduction prevents one-model observations from becoming repairs.

tasks.problem_context: A reproduced problem may require a capability or architecture change.
tasks.title: Propose Evolution
tasks.value_hypothesis: Explicit proposals keep semantic evolution reviewable and reversible.

tasks.problem_context: An authorized sandbox implementation scope exists.
tasks.title: Build Patch Variant
tasks.value_hypothesis: Multiple bounded variants improve selection without mutating production.

tasks.problem_context: Patch variants and test evidence are available.
relevance_conditions: at least two repair choices and no-change baseline
tasks.title: Evaluate Variant
tasks.value_hypothesis: Independent evidence-driven selection prevents builder self-approval.

tasks.problem_context: An evolution proposal or selected variant needs authority review.
tasks.title: Audit Authority Boundary
tasks.value_hypothesis: Independent boundary review keeps evolution subordinate to governance.

tasks.problem_context: A separately authorized activation has a canary and rollback plan.
tasks.title: Observe Canary
tasks.value_hypothesis: Outcome observation distinguishes selected variants from retained evolution.

tasks.problem_context: A version-pinned external report alleges a relevant problem.
tasks.title: Reproduce External Evidence
tasks.value_hypothesis: External evidence can improve adaptation while preserving source and limitations.
